Verified:

- **`MasterDetailForm.tsx` (+41 / −5)**: one `React.useId()`-scoped `outcomeToastId` (the `form-outcome:` spelling PR #7342 uses); `handleSaved`'s `toast.success` and `handleError`'s `toast.error` carry `{ id: outcomeToastId }`; `toast.dismiss(outcomeToastId)` at the top of `handleSave`; the three `useCallback` dependency lists gain the id. Durations untouched; the console host's `onSuccess` branch untouched — and pinned: with `onSuccess` supplied the built-in confirmation is skipped, so the dismissal is the load-bearing half there (ablation leg B: dropping the dismissal turned exactly that case red, falsifying the dispatch's guess that the pin might stay green).
- **Pin** `MasterDetailForm.outcomeToastSupersede.test.tsx` (3 cases) mocks `@object-ui/components/ui/sonner` — measured as the module both spellings resolve to (the form imports `toast` from `@object-ui/components`, whose root re-exports the wrapper; the vitest alias maps the package to `src`). Red-first 3/3 with the card's own registry `[error, success]`; green `[success]`.
- **Four fixtures outside the declared surface**, accepted as declared: `MasterDetailForm.test.tsx`, `masterDetailFormTypeVocabulary.test.tsx`, `submitHandlerSeam.test.tsx`, `submitTargetRefusal.test.tsx` each replaced the whole `toast` export with a hand-listed `{ success, error }` double and died on `toast.dismiss` (16 failures, none about their own assertions); each now spreads `...actual.toast` and overrides only what it spies on. The alternative — an optional-call in the renderer to accommodate an incomplete double — was rightly rejected.
